Name: MAP_NAME_TEX_PARAM_ST_DLC02
Description: Place names and BGM / ambient-sound places per part of the Realm of Shadow (m61; the overworld uses MapNameTexParam). The game reads the map info texture of the 1024 m tile the player is on (256 × 256 pixels, 4 m per pixel, north up): the green channel of the pixel under the player is the row ID (0–255). Each row either sets one set of values for the whole area, or splits it into a low and a high part by the player's height (Separate by High and Low Altitudes). No row for that value: no place name and no sound places. The game ignores this param unless its data version is 2 or higher (retail: 2).

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.
Padding.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Source Image Colour: Red
Fields.Description: Red of this area's colour in the painted source map image. Only the conversion tool uses it: the game reads the converted texture, whose pixel holds the row ID itself. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Source Image Colour: Green
Fields.Description: Green of this area's colour in the painted source map image. Only the conversion tool uses it: the game reads the converted texture, whose pixel holds the row ID itself. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Source Image Colour: Blue
Fields.Description: Blue of this area's colour in the painted source map image. Only the conversion tool uses it: the game reads the converted texture, whose pixel holds the row ID itself. Appears unused by the game.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Place Name ID
Fields.Description: PlaceName text of this area, shown by the place-name banner; the text is the absolute value and the sign picks when the banner appears. Negative: shown each time the player enters from an area with a different name. Positive: shown only if no place-name banner has been shown since the last reset, so walking in from a named neighbouring area shows nothing. 0: no name. Also the default save location name (MapPieceTexParam_m61). Used only while Separate by High and Low Altitudes is off.

Fields.Name: BGM Place
Fields.Description: BGM place of this area; it replaces the map's MapDefaultInfoParam BGM Place. Sound overrides set by the game still take precedence. 999: not set, the map's value is used. Used only while Separate by High and Low Altitudes is off.

Fields.Name: Ambient Sound Place
Fields.Description: Ambient-sound place of this area; it replaces the map's MapDefaultInfoParam Ambient Sound Place. A sound override set by the game still takes precedence. 999: not set, the map's value is used. Used only while Separate by High and Low Altitudes is off.

Fields.Name: Separate by High and Low Altitudes
Fields.Description: On (non-zero): the row uses its Low Altitude and High Altitude fields, picked by the player's height against High / Low Altitude Boundary Height, and its plain Place Name ID, BGM Place and Ambient Sound Place are ignored. Off: the plain fields apply and the Low/High fields are ignored.
Padding.

Fields.Name: High / Low Altitude Boundary Height
Fields.Description: Height in whole metres that splits the area when Separate by High and Low Altitudes is on. The player's height is their vertical position in the Realm of Shadow map's own coordinates: above this value the High Altitude fields apply, at or below it the Low Altitude fields. Can be negative (retail -200 to 530 on split rows).
Padding.

Fields.Name: Low Altitude: Place Name ID
Fields.Description: Place Name ID used while the player is at or below the boundary height (Separate by High and Low Altitudes on); same sign rules as Place Name ID. 0: no name.

Fields.Name: High Altitude: Place Name ID
Fields.Description: Place Name ID used while the player is above the boundary height (Separate by High and Low Altitudes on); same sign rules as Place Name ID. 0: no name.

Fields.Name: Low Altitude: BGM Place
Fields.Description: BGM Place used while the player is at or below the boundary height (Separate by High and Low Altitudes on). 999: not set, the map's value is used.

Fields.Name: High Altitude: BGM Place
Fields.Description: BGM Place used while the player is above the boundary height (Separate by High and Low Altitudes on). 999: not set, the map's value is used.

Fields.Name: Low Altitude: Ambient Sound Place
Fields.Description: Ambient Sound Place used while the player is at or below the boundary height (Separate by High and Low Altitudes on). 999: not set, the map's value is used.

Fields.Name: High Altitude: Ambient Sound Place
Fields.Description: Ambient Sound Place used while the player is above the boundary height (Separate by High and Low Altitudes on). 999: not set, the map's value is used.
